provenance.prompt:
Use the portrait and gameplay sprites as the exact Marco Vellum identity and style reference. Marco is a compact, athletic adult HUMAN MAN with medium-light olive skin, strong clean-shaven masculine face, short thick black hair with a slight wave. He has NO mustache or beard and NO long hair. He wears a black Blackthorn Court Kings jersey and shorts with crimson/red piping and white trim, black wristbands, black high-top shoes. Preserve the same identity in all ten poses; do not transfer any other Blackthorn athlete's traits.

Create a transparent RGBA 1536x1024 sheet, exactly 5 columns by 2 rows, strict row-major. Exactly ten distinct complete full-body basketball jump-shot poses. Each cell is 307x512 pixels: draw each figure at about 60% of cell height, centered with at least 70 transparent pixels above and below and at least 25 transparent pixels at both sides. No body part may cross a cell edge or row divider. Keep every head, hand, limb and shoe fully visible inside its own cell. Do not use oversized figures.

Sequence: 0 balanced; 1 gathers empty hands around invisible ball at waist; 2 bends knees and brings hands to chest; 3 raises hands toward forehead, shooting hand under invisible ball and guide hand beside it; 4 bends deeper; 5 rises into a small jump; 6 shooting arm extends upward while guide hand separates; 7 high wrist-flick follow-through, fingers relaxed, hands empty; 8 descends with arm held high; 9 lands and lowers arm. No ball anywhere, no object, no hoop, no court, no shadow, no background, no text or other figures. The ball is separate Marco-specific runtime art.

Use crisp 1990s arcade pixel/cel art with the gameplay reference's proportions, colors and dark outline. All ten faces remain clean-shaven with short waved black hair. True alpha-zero background and wide gutters. Return only the sheet.

review.notes: Ten complete, centered, cell-separated poses preserve Marco as a compact clean-shaven adult man with short waved black hair, olive skin and black/crimson/white kit. Sequential gather, shot set, rise, empty hand follow-through, descent and landing. There is no basketball anywhere in the accepted source.

ballTrack.art: no ball in poses; independently animated Marco-specific runtime path

cleanup.method: For each cell retain the largest alpha>=32 athlete component plus only its 2px antialias fringe; packer confirms ten separate full bodies, cell containment and normalized atlas.

generationHistory.reason: Pose 2 had a baked basketball and raised poses crossed the strict 5x2 cell boundary.
Localized ball removal succeeded, but the source still had bottom-row poses touching/crossing cell boundaries.
